Zabljak, Borje II. 5 km from the city center, 40 meters from the Zabljak - Mojkovac highway in a pine forest, 9 km from the Savin Kuk ski lifts, 12 km from the Djurashevich bridge on the Tara River (rafting, zip line). Wooden house of 20 sq. m on a plot of 300 sq. m. Plot of land in a pine forest, access road, electricity, running water. Altitude above sea level – 1300 meters. The house needs finishing work and installation of a bathroom; adaptation and accommodation are possible. The best solution is to dismantle and build a new house or chalet on the site of the existing building. Cost 35,000 euros + 3% commission to the company. Urgent sale.
